newsitem.title: UK: China needs 300,000 tns of copper this year-Asarco.
newsitem.headline: China needs 300,000 tns of copper this year-Asarco.

text.p: China is expected to require around 300,000 tonnes of copper from the West this year, although their intentions are unclear, ASARCO Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard de J. Osborne said.
"They will take around 300,000 tonnes of refined copper from the West this year," Osborne said to reporters after an analyst briefing.
China has changed its buying pattern in recent years - sometimes taking scrap or sometimes concentrate. But it still amounts to a unit of copper, he said.
Also, the Chinese are less obvious when it comes to their operations and activities in the market.
"They have worked hard to not signal their intentions...and there have been recent announcements that their requirements will be less," he said.
However, China is undoubtedly short of copper, and shorts usually talk their books, not their beliefs.
